contract: Saved experiments accept integer maxWorkers 1-4, default 1; named run preparation pins the limit; workflow targets reject values above 1 before queueing; declaration import preserves the agent worker count.

examples: Experiment import saved a reviewed suite and experiment without starting AI.
Parallel example executed six synthetic cases with maximum two concurrent workers and no external model calls.
validation.static: New/affected focused Python lint, new-file format checks, JavaScript syntax and diff whitespace pass. Existing studio_operations.py:83 B904 remains; the identical warning was confirmed on HEAD and was not changed.
validation.browser: Pending. The prior localhost permission denial was not retried or bypassed.
validation.live_provider: Not invoked; synthetic in-process provider concurrency only.

guarantees: Worker bounds include target and judge as a single in-flight pair
Out-of-order completion produces canonical variant/case/repetition result order
Per-variant thresholds cannot be hidden by a stronger variant
Invocation traces attach target and judge to case checkpoints without parent text-stream races
File and SQL restart retain completed results and dispatched ordinals
SQL child tasks inherit one parent job lease and fencing token
Errors stop new dispatch; already-started slots drain and retain outcomes
Cancellation waits for owned task cleanup; external effects may still complete
Dispatched slots with missing or failed results cannot replay on accidental executor reentry
Queued source edits and forged incoming settings cannot expand the pinned worker count
Native import, plan/apply and export preserve maxWorkers without starting runs
limits: Parallelism supports agent targets; workflow experiments require one worker
Multiple evaluators and external-format experiment export remain pending
No generic retry for uncertain agent/tool effects; starting a new run is deliberate repetition
Worker limit is per experiment, within existing Studio job scheduling
Account-specific provider concurrency, visual browser and physical-device checks remain pending
migration: Additive optional maxWorkers field; old records default to one. Older runtimes require an update before accepting configurations with the new field.
next: Reviewed multi-evaluator configuration and aggregation retaining primary evaluator identity and individual results.
